baitlist 0.4.1.0000
  • Reference

Fits the responses in a BAIT binary logistic regression model for each respondent group

fit_bait_binary.Rd

Uses the apollo package for modelling.

Usage

fit_bait_binary(elimination_threshold = 0.2)

Arguments

elimination_threshold

Performs step-wise backward elimination of least significant coefficients using p > elimination_threshold. Default: 0.20. To disable backward elimination of coefficients set elimination_threshold = 1

Examples

fit_bait_binary()
